doc: Approach B candidates: browser-internal flags that may cut RAM or CPU per profile (spec 2026-10-31-fb-light-b-design.md, local).
gate: scripts/verify_light_flag.py, the oracle page with and without the flag in the fork; pass means no page-readable leaf moved.

measured: arm 3w -Flags against two flag-less baselines; kept means the target process fell 10 % in peak and mean, beyond the baselines' spread, CPU rose 10 % at most and no page load rose more than 20 %.
observe-auto -Flags takes only gate=pass. settings/launcher.json launch.light_args holds exactly the kept flags, in this order.
A flag never contains ',' (observe-auto -Flags splits on it).
